name: SDN Decision Gate
description: Single-purpose flow gate nodes for the routing-decision JSON contract (foundation/http-route). Method "dispatch" fans a decision frame out to route-specific output ports: route=omm_bulk -> an SDS $CAQ envelope (CAQRequest.QUERY = decision.query JSON) on "omm_bulk" plus the decision passthrough on "routed"; route=data_query -> a $CAQ envelope (CAQRequest.QUERY = {"sql","params"} JSON) on "data_query" plus "routed"; anything else -> the decision passthrough on "not_found". Method "branch" joins the decision with a retrieval stream and fans out per decision.format: the stream passes VERBATIM on "flatbuffer" (default) or "json" (for JSON encoding downstream), the decision passes through on "decision", and a deterministic FNV-1a 64-bit hex entity tag computed over the stream bytes is emitted on "etag". Branching therefore stays declarative at the flow level: static edges from route/format-specific output ports. Pure compute — no capabilities. Body-reference delivery (loop C.5c): dispatch injects "deliver":"ref" into the retrieval query JSON when decision.format != json (the flatbuffer stream passes to the response body verbatim, so the host may keep the bytes and hand back a reference); branch recognizes {"$sdnbodyref":..} descriptor frames and formats their host-computed fnv1a64 field into the same W/"fnv1a64-<hex>" entity tag it would compute by hashing the stream bytes.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Routing-decision UTF-8 JSON bytes from foundation/http-route (aligned-binary wire format): {"route","format","ifNoneMatch"?,"query"?,"sql"?,"params"?,"error"?}.
SDS catalog query envelope for data-source/retrieval omm_bulk: CAQRequest.QUERY carries decision.query as a JSON override object {schema,source,profile,epoch,limit}.
SDS catalog query envelope for data-source/retrieval data_query: CAQRequest.QUERY carries {"sql":"...","params":[...]} JSON from the decision.
The decision JSON passthrough, emitted alongside omm_bulk/data_query so the format branch can join it with the retrieval stream.
The decision JSON passthrough for unroutable requests, wired straight to http-respond (404).

outputPorts.description: Emitted only when the decision is not a data route.

methods.description: Converts the decision into route-specific typed frames: $CAQ requests for the retrieval methods, decision passthroughs for the join and the 404 path.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Routing-decision UTF-8 JSON bytes (aligned-binary wire format).

inputPorts.description: The decision controlling the format branch.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Retrieval result bytes passed through verbatim: an ALIGNED size-prefixed FlatBuffer stream ($OMM for omm_bulk, generic aligned rows for data_query).
The stream verbatim when decision.format=flatbuffer (default): wired straight to http-respond body.
The stream verbatim when decision.format=json, typed as the $OMM aligned stream so it wires into foundation/omm-json encode.
The decision JSON passthrough, emitted together with the branched stream so http-respond joins decision+body atomically.
Deterministic entity tag over the stream bytes as raw UTF-8 string bytes: W/"fnv1a64-<16 hex digits>". Matches http-respond's etag input/If-None-Match comparison.

outputPorts.description: Entity tag for conditional requests (always emitted).

methods.description: Joins decision+stream, forwards the stream on the format-specific port, and emits the decision passthrough plus a deterministic FNV-1a etag.
